statement: The planner signs a reserve payment only if the reserve covers it, always; oldest first, skipping one that does not fit. The Quint cell holds the cover half: a payment is not signed when the reserve does not cover it (unfunded-payment-is-signed); the oldest-first order and the skipping of one that does not fit carry no id there.
